hero.overline: आज की पेशी, कल की तैयारी।

pricing.title: Priced like one consultation.

footer.tagline: Making Indian litigation legible — for the advocates who run it and the citizens who live through it.

analytics.receivablesNote: Receivables/invoicing analytics fill in once invoice assembly ships (keyless, in the backlog).
analytics.storageNote: Stored in Supabase Postgres (RLS-isolated to your tenant). Document files live in a private Storage bucket; their semantic embeddings in document_chunk (pgvector). Court records are cached in a shared court_cache ({cached} cases cached) and copied into your matters. Court-data ingestion health + cache stats are on Settings → Court data.
